title: एकोनत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 29 · Duryodhana hides in the lake

summary.en: Left alone, Duryodhana flees to a lake and by his magic power stops its waters and lies hidden in it, while the three surviving Kaurava warriors rest nearby. Hunters tell Bhima where he has gone.
summary.kn: ಒಬ್ಬಂಟಿಯಾದ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಸರೋವರಕ್ಕೆ ಓಡಿ ಮಾಯಾಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀರನ್ನು ತಡೆದು ಅದರೊಳಗೆ ಅಡಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಉಳಿದ ಮೂವರು ಕೌರವ ವೀರರು ಹತ್ತಿರ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಬೇಟೆಗಾರರು ಅವನು ಹೋದ ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ಭೀಮನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: अकेला दुर्योधन एक सरोवर में भागकर माया की शक्ति से उसका जल रोक देता है और उसमें छिप जाता है, जबकि तीन बचे कौरव योद्धा पास विश्राम करते हैं। शिकारी भीम को बताते हैं कि वह कहाँ गया है।
summary.te: ఒంటరైన దుర్యోధనుడు సరస్సుకు పారిపోయి మాయాశక్తితో దాని నీటిని ఆపి లోపల దాక్కుంటాడు; మిగిలిన ముగ్గురు కౌరవ వీరులు సమీపంలో విశ్రమిస్తారు. అతడు వెళ్లిన చోటును బోయలు భీమునికి చెబుతారు.
summary.ta: தனியான துரியோதனன் ஒரு குளத்துக்கு ஓடி மாயசக்தியால் அதன் நீரைத் தடுத்து உள்ளே ஒளிகிறான்; எஞ்சிய மூன்று கௌரவ வீரர் அருகில் ஓய்வெடுக்கின்றனர். அவன் சென்ற இடத்தை வேடர்கள் பீமனுக்குக் கூறுகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: തനിച്ചായ ദുര്യോധനൻ ഒരു തടാകത്തിലേക്ക് ഓടുന്നു; തന്റെ മായാശക്തിയാൽ അതിലെ വെള്ളം തടഞ്ഞുനിർത്തി അതിനുള്ളിൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. സമീപത്ത് ശേഷിച്ച മൂന്ന് കൗരവ യോദ്ധാക്കൾ വിശ്രമിക്കുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹം എവിടെ പോയി എന്ന് വേട്ടക്കാർ ഭീമനെ അറിയിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.29; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
हतेषु सर्वसैन्येषु पाण्डुपुत्रै रणाजिरे ।
मम सैन्यावशिष्टास्ते किमकुर्वत संजय ॥

meaning.en: When all the armies had been killed in the battlefield by the sons of Pandu, what did those of my army who remained do, Sanjaya?

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा कृपश्चैव द्रोणपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान् ।
दुर्योधनश्च मन्दात्मा राजा किमकरोत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: What did Kritavarman, Kripa, the mighty son of Drona and the foolish king Duryodhana do then?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
संप्राद्रवत्सु दारेषु क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम् ।
विद्रुते शिबिरे शून्ये भृशोद्विग्नास्त्रयो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: When the wives of the great-souled kshatriyas had fled and the camp, abandoned, stood empty, the three chariot-fighters were deeply troubled.

verses.text:
निशम्य पाण्डुपुत्राणां तदा विजयिनां स्वनम् ।
विद्रुतं शिबिरं दृष्ट्वा सायाह्ने राजगृद्धिनः ।
स्थानं नारोचयंस्तत्र ततस्ते ह्रदमभ्ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the roar of the victorious sons of Pandu and seeing the camp deserted that evening, they, devoted to the king, did not like staying there, and went to the lake.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरोऽपि धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः सहितो रणे ।
हृष्टः पर्यपतद्राजन्दुर्योधनवधेप्सया ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira too, righteous in spirit, with his brothers, rushed joyfully into the battle, wishing to kill Duryodhana, O king.

verses.text:
मार्गमाणास्तु संक्रुद्धास्तव पुत्रं जयैषिणः ।
यत्नतोऽन्वेषमाणास्तु नैवापश्यञ्जनाधिपम् ॥

meaning.en: Enraged and eager for victory, they searched for your son, looking carefully, but did not see the lord of men.

verses.text:
स हि तीव्रेण वेगेन गदापाणिरपाक्रमत् ।
तं ह्रदं प्राविशच्चापि विष्टभ्यापः स्वमायया ॥

meaning.en: For he had gone away at high speed, mace in hand, and had entered that lake, stilling its water by his own power of illusion.

verses.text:
यदा तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे सुपरिश्रान्तवाहनाः ।
ततः स्वशिबिरं प्राप्य व्यतिष्ठन्सहसैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: When all the Pandavas, their mounts utterly weary, had reached their own camp, they halted there with their troops.

verses.text:
ततः कृपश्च द्रौणिश्च कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः ।
संनिविष्टेषु पार्थेषु प्रयातास्तं ह्रदं शनैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, while the Parthas were settled, Kripa, Drona's son and the Satvata Kritavarman went slowly to that lake.

verses.text:
ते तं ह्रदं समासाद्य यत्र शेते जनाधिपः ।
अभ्यभाषन्त दुर्धर्षं राजानं सुप्तमम्भसि ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the lake where the lord of men lay, they spoke to the invincible king, who lay asleep in the water.

verses.text:
राजन्नुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व सहास्माभिर्युधिष्ठिरम् ।
जित्वा वा पृथिवीं भुङ्क्ष्व हतो वा स्वर्गमाप्नुहि ॥

meaning.en: "Rise, O king, and fight Yudhishthira with us; either win and enjoy the earth, or be killed and attain heaven.

verses.text:
तेषामपि बलं सर्वं हतं दुर्योधन त्वया ।
प्रतिरब्धाश्च भूयिष्ठं ये शिष्टास्तत्र सैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: All their force has been destroyed by you, Duryodhana, and the soldiers who remain there are mostly stunned.

verses.text:
न ते वेगं विषहितुं शक्तास्तव विशां पते ।
अस्माभिरभिगुप्तस्य तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ भारत ॥

meaning.en: They cannot bear your onset, O lord of the people, when you are guarded by us. Therefore rise, O Bharata."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या पश्यामि वो मुक्तानीदृशात्पुरुषक्षयात् ।
पाण्डुकौरवसंमर्दाज्जीवमानान्नरर्षभान् ॥

meaning.en: "By good fortune I see you freed from such a slaughter of men, alive, bulls among men, out of the crush between the Pandavas and Kauravas.

verses.text:
विजेष्यामो वयं सर्वे विश्रान्ता विगतक्लमाः ।
भवन्तश्च परिश्रान्ता वयं च भृशविक्षताः ।
उदीर्णं च बलं तेषां तेन युद्धं न रोचये ॥

meaning.en: We will all win once we are rested and free of weariness. You are tired and I am badly wounded, and their force is strong; so I do not want to fight now.

verses.text:
न त्वेतदद्भुतं वीरा यद्वो महदिदं मनः ।
अस्मासु च परा भक्तिर्न तु कालः पराक्रमे ॥

meaning.en: It is no wonder, heroes, that your spirit is so high and your devotion to me so great, but this is not the time for valor.

verses.text:
विश्रम्यैकां निशामद्य भवद्भिः सहितो रणे ।
प्रतियोत्स्याम्यहं शत्रूञ्श्वो न मेऽस्त्यत्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Having rested one night, I will, together with you, face the enemy in battle tomorrow; of this I have no doubt."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीद्द्रौणी राजानं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।
उत्तिष्ठ राजन्भद्रं ते विजेष्यामो रणे परान् ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, Drona's son said to the king, wild for battle: "Rise, O king, good fortune to you; we will defeat the enemy in the battle.

verses.text:
इष्टापूर्तेन दानेन सत्येन च जपेन च ।
शपे राजन्यथा ह्यद्य निहनिष्यामि सोमकान् ॥

meaning.en: By my sacrifices and works of merit, by my gifts, by truth and by prayer I swear, O king, that today I will kill the Somakas.

verses.text:
मा स्म यज्ञकृतां प्रीतिं प्राप्नुयां सज्जनोचिताम् ।
यदीमां रजनीं व्युष्टां न निहन्मि परान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: May I never gain the favor of those who perform sacrifices, fitting for the good, if, when this night has dawned, I do not kill the enemy in the battle.

verses.text:
नाहत्वा सर्वपाञ्चालान्विमोक्ष्ये कवचं विभो ।
इति सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतत्तन्मे शृणु जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: I will not take off my armor, O lord, without killing all the Panchalas. I tell you this truth; hear it, O lord of the people."

verses.text:
तेषु संभाषमाणेषु व्याधास्तं देशमाययुः ।
मांसभारपरिश्रान्ताः पानीयार्थं यदृच्छया ॥

meaning.en: While they were speaking, hunters came to that place by chance, weary from carrying loads of meat, in search of water.

verses.text:
ते हि नित्यं महाराज भीमसेनस्य लुब्धकाः ।
मांसभारानुपाजह्रुर्भक्त्या परमया विभो ॥

meaning.en: Those hunters, O great king, always brought loads of meat to Bhimasena with great devotion, O lord.

verses.text:
ते तत्र विष्ठितास्तेषां सर्वं तद्वचनं रहः ।
दुर्योधनवचश्चैव शुश्रुवुः संगता मिथः ॥

meaning.en: Standing there in secret, they heard all that talk of theirs and Duryodhana's words, as they conferred with one another.

verses.text:
तेऽपि सर्वे महेष्वासा अयुद्धार्थिनि कौरवे ।
निर्बन्धं परमं चक्रुस्तदा वै युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: Those great archers, wishing to fight, pressed the Kaurava very hard, though he did not want to fight.

verses.text:
तांस्तथा समुदीक्ष्याथ कौरवाणां महारथान् ।
अयुद्धमनसं चैव राजानं स्थितमम्भसि ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those great chariot-fighters of the Kauravas like that, and the king remaining in the water with no mind for battle,

verses.text:
तेषां श्रुत्वा च संवादं राज्ञश्च सलिले सतः ।
व्याधाभ्यजानन्राजेन्द्र सलिलस्थं सुयोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: and hearing the conversation of those men with the king staying in the water, the hunters, O king of kings, recognized Suyodhana in the water.

verses.text:
ते पूर्वं पाण्डुपुत्रेण पृष्टा ह्यासन्सुतं तव ।
यदृच्छोपगतास्तत्र राजानं परिमार्गिताः ॥

meaning.en: They had earlier been asked by the Pandava about your son, and had come there by chance while the king was being sought.

verses.text:
ततस्ते पाण्डुपुत्रस्य स्मृत्वा तद्भाषितं तदा ।
अन्योन्यमब्रुवन्राजन्मृगव्याधाः शनैरिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, remembering what the son of Pandu had said, those deer-hunters said to one another, softly, O king:

verses.text:
दुर्योधनं ख्यापयामो धनं दास्यति पाण्डवः ।
सुव्यक्तमिति नः ख्यातो ह्रदे दुर्योधनो नृपः ॥

meaning.en: "Let us reveal Duryodhana; the Pandava will give us wealth. It is clearly known to us that King Duryodhana is in the lake.

verses.text:
तस्माद्गच्छामहे सर्वे यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः ।
आख्यातुं सलिले सुप्तं दुर्योधनममर्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: So let us all go where King Yudhishthira is, to tell him that the wrathful Duryodhana lies asleep in the water.

verses.text:
धृतराष्ट्रात्मजं तस्मै भीमसेनाय धीमते ।
शयानं सलिले सर्वे कथयामो धनुर्भृते ॥

meaning.en: We will tell the wise bow-bearing Bhimasena that the son of Dhritarashtra is lying in the water.

verses.text:
स नो दास्यति सुप्रीतो धनानि बहुलान्युत ।
किं नो मांसेन शुष्केण परिक्लिष्टेन शोषिणा ॥

meaning.en: He will give us much wealth, being highly pleased. What use to us is dried, troublesome, withering meat?"

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो व्याधाः संप्रहृष्टा धनार्थिनः ।
मांसभारानुपादाय प्रययुः शिबिरं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the hunters, delighted and wanting wealth, took up their loads of meat and went to the camp.

verses.text:
पाण्डवाश्च महाराज लब्धलक्षाः प्रहारिणः ।
अपश्यमानाः समरे दुर्योधनमवस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, O great king, who had hit their marks and struck down their foes, not seeing Duryodhana anywhere in the battle,

verses.text:
निकृतेस्तस्य पापस्य ते पारं गमनेप्सवः ।
चारान्संप्रेषयामासुः समन्तात्तद्रणाजिरम् ॥

meaning.en: and wishing to reach the end of that sinner's treachery, sent spies all around the battlefield.

verses.text:
आगम्य तु ततः सर्वे नष्टं दुर्योधनं नृपम् ।
न्यवेदयन्त सहिता धर्मराजस्य सैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the king's soldiers returned and reported together to the king of dharma that King Duryodhana had vanished.

verses.text:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चाराणां भरतर्षभ ।
चिन्तामभ्यगमत्तीव्रां निशश्वास च पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those spies' words, O bull of the Bharatas, the king fell into deep anxiety and sighed.

verses.text:
अथ स्थितानां पाण्डूनां दीनानां भरतर्षभ ।
तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य त्वरिता लुब्धका विभो ॥

meaning.en: Then, while the dejected Pandavas stayed on, O bull of the Bharatas, the hunters hurried away from that place, O lord,

verses.text:
आजग्मुः शिबिरं हृष्टा दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं नृपम् ।
वार्यमाणाः प्रविष्टाश्च भीमसेनस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: and came joyfully to the camp, having seen King Duryodhana; though held back, they entered before Bhimasena's eyes.

verses.text:
ते तु पाण्डवमासाद्य भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।
तस्मै तत्सर्वमाचख्युर्यद्वृत्तं यच्च वै श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the mighty Pandava Bhimasena, they told him everything, what had happened and what they had heard.

verses.text:
ततो वृकोदरो राजन्दत्त्वा तेषां धनं बहु ।
धर्मराजाय तत्सर्वमाचचक्षे परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: Then Vrikodara, O king, scorcher of foes, gave them much wealth and told it all to Yudhishthira, king of dharma.

verses.text:
असौ दुर्योधनो राजन्विज्ञातो मम लुब्धकैः ।
संस्तभ्य सलिलं शेते यस्यार्थे परितप्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "O king, my hunters have found out this Duryodhana, for whose sake you grieve: he lies there, having stilled the water."

verses.text:
तद्वचो भीमसेनस्य प्रियं श्रुत्वा विशां पते ।
अजातशत्रुः कौन्तेयो हृष्टोऽभूत्सह सोदरैः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those welcome words of Bhimasena, O lord of the people, Kunti's son Yudhishthira, the Ajatashatru, was glad, with his brothers.

verses.text:
तं च श्रुत्वा महेष्वासं प्रविष्टं सलिलह्रदम् ।
क्षिप्रमेव ततोऽगच्छत्पुरस्कृत्य जनार्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that the great archer had entered the lake, he went there quickly, putting Janardana in front.

verses.text:
ततः किलकिलाशब्दः प्रादुरासीद्विशां पते ।
पाण्डवानां प्रहृष्टानां पाञ्चालानां च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Then a joyful din arose, O lord of the people, from the Pandavas and the Panchalas on every side, all rejoicing.

verses.text:
सिंहनादांस्ततश्चक्रुः क्ष्वेडांश्च भरतर्षभ ।
त्वरिताः क्षत्रिया राजञ्जग्मुर्द्वैपायनं ह्रदम् ॥

meaning.en: They gave lion-roars and shouts, O bull of the Bharatas, and the kshatriyas hurried, O king, to the Dvaipayana lake.

verses.text:
ज्ञातः पापो धार्तराष्ट्रो दृष्टश्चेत्यसकृद्रणे ।
प्राक्रोशन्सोमकास्तत्र हृष्टरूपाः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: "The sinful Dhartarashtra has been found, he has been seen!" cried the Somakas there again and again in the battle, their faces glad on every side.

verses.text:
तेषामाशु प्रयातानां रथानां तत्र वेगिनाम् ।
बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो दिवस्पृक्पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: As their swift chariots sped quickly there, O lord of the earth, a tumultuous sound rose that touched the sky.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनं परीप्सन्तस्तत्र तत्र युधिष्ठिरम् ।
अन्वयुस्त्वरितास्ते वै राजानं श्रान्तवाहनाः ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to catch Duryodhana, they hurried after King Yudhishthira here and there, their mounts weary.

verses.text:
अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ।
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी चापराजितः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna, Bhimasena, the two Pandava sons of Madri, the Panchala Dhrishtadyumna, the unconquered Shikhandi,

verses.text:
उत्तमौजा युधामन्युः सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ।
पाञ्चालानां च ये शिष्टा द्रौपदेयाश्च भारत ।
हयाश्च सर्वे नागाश्च शतशश्च पदातयः ॥

meaning.en: Uttamauja, Yudhamanyu, the unconquered Satyaki, the surviving Panchalas and the sons of Draupadi, O Bharata, and all the horses and elephants and hundreds of foot soldiers.

verses.text:
ततः प्राप्तो महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
द्वैपायनह्रदं ख्यातं यत्र दुर्योधनोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O great king, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, reached the famed Dvaipayana lake, where Duryodhana was,

verses.text:
शीतामलजलं हृद्यं द्वितीयमिव सागरम् ।
मायया सलिलं स्तभ्य यत्राभूत्ते सुतः स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: its water cool, clear and charming, like a second ocean, where your son stayed, having stilled the water by illusion.

verses.text:
अत्यद्भुतेन विधिना दैवयोगेन भारत ।
सलिलान्तर्गतः शेते दुर्दर्शः कस्यचित्प्रभो ।
मानुषस्य मनुष्येन्द्र गदाहस्तो जनाधिपः ॥

meaning.en: By a most wondrous device, O Bharata, through the working of fate, the king lay hidden in the water, hard for any human to see, mace in hand, O lord of men.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सलितान्तर्गतो वसन् ।
शुश्रुवे तुमुलं शब्दं जलदोपमनिःस्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, living within the water, heard a tumultuous noise like the roar of clouds.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्तु राजेन्द्र ह्रदं तं सह सोदरैः ।
आजगाम महाराज तव पुत्रवधाय वै ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, O king of kings, with his brothers, came to that lake, O great king, to kill your son.

verses.text:
महता शङ्खनादेन रथनेमिस्वनेन च ।
उद्धुन्वंश्च महारेणुं कम्पयंश्चापि मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: With a great blast of conches and the rumble of chariot wheels, raising a huge cloud of dust and shaking the earth,

verses.text:
यौधिष्ठिरस्य सैन्यस्य श्रुत्वा शब्दं महारथाः ।
कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणी राजानमिदमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: the great chariot-fighters Kritavarman, Kripa and Drona's son, hearing the noise of Yudhishthira's army, said to the king:

verses.text:
इमे ह्यायान्ति संहृष्टाः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः ।
अपयास्यामहे तावदनुजानातु नो भवान् ॥

meaning.en: "Here come the Pandavas, joyful, looking victorious. Let us go away for now; give us leave."

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा तेषां तत्र यशस्विनाम् ।
तथेत्युक्त्वा ह्रदं तं वै माययास्तम्भयत्प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Hearing their words, Duryodhana said "So be it" to those renowned men, O lord, and again stilled the lake by illusion.

verses.text:
ते त्वनुज्ञाप्य राजानं भृशं शोकपरायणाः ।
जग्मुर्दूरं महाराज कृपप्रभृतयो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: Having taken the king's leave, deeply given to grief, Kripa and the other chariot-fighters went far, O great king.

verses.text:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं न्यग्रोधं प्रेक्ष्य मारिष ।
न्यविशन्त भृशं श्रान्ताश्चिन्तयन्तो नृपं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Having gone a long way, O revered one, they saw a banyan tree and sat down beneath it, very weary, thinking about the king.

verses.text:
विष्टभ्य सलिलं सुप्तो धार्तराष्ट्रो महाबलः ।
पाण्डवाश्चापि संप्राप्तास्तं देशं युद्धमीप्सवः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Dhartarashtra lay asleep with the water stilled, and the Pandavas arrived at that place, eager for battle.

verses.text:
कथं नु युद्धं भविता कथं राजा भविष्यति ।
कथं नु पाण्डवा राजन्प्रतिपत्स्यन्ति कौरवम् ॥

meaning.en: "How will the battle be? How will the king fare? How, O king, will the Pandavas deal with the Kaurava?"

verses.text:
इत्येवं चिन्तयन्तस्ते रथेभ्योऽश्वान्विमुच्य ह ।
तत्रासां चक्रिरे राजन्कृपप्रभृतयो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: Thinking thus, Kripa and the other chariot-fighters unyoked their horses from the chariots and rested there, O king.
